change_summary: Return the smallest safe canonical reader links when Corvio evidence materially grounds an answer, while keeping read-only, no-link, privacy, and source-volume boundaries intact.

canonical_skill.note: The shared Skill returns only the current reader links needed to verify or continue an answer materially grounded by Corvio, without forcing writes or link dumps.

server_contract.note: The shared collaboration contract exposes the same bounded read-grounded handoff decision point to MCP and CLI consumers.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.26 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.1.

workspace_cli.note: The CLI command surface remains compatible and receives the updated shared collaboration contract from the server.

help_center.note: MCP Help explains that materially grounding a result should return the smallest safe canonical reader links for verification or continuation.

package_setup.note: Package guidance mirrors the bounded canonical-link return rule; the compact Claude hook remains unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: The longitudinal Harness separates same-Host baselines from explicit cross-Host portability and records the two Claude link-return misses as behavioral evidence.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover evidence-lane attribution, the bounded reader-link instruction, shared contract metadata and package version parity.
